##### Project general facts

Six Senses Residences, Dubai is the UAE's first branded residential development by the world-renowned Six Senses brand. This iconic project epitomizes innovative architecture, taking its cues from Dubai's journey while paying homage to the contours and elevations of the region's landscape. Developed by Select Group, a multidisciplinary developer with over two decades of industry-leading experience, the residences feature Signature Villas, Penthouses, and Sky Villas, each designed to create an everlasting connection with the deep.

At the core of the development is a wellness and lifestyle facility, Six Senses Place, providing residential owners with a new dimension in community living. This unique space adopts the Six Senses belief that wellness is anything and everything that results in mental, physical, spiritual, and emotional happiness. Residents benefit from an array of facilities including a massage circuit pool, squash court, wellness circuit, Six Senses Spa, shared working space, and meeting rooms. Owner benefits include daily servicing, laundry, concierge, butler services, and savings on spa, food, and beverage.

Every residence at Six Senses Residences is a masterpiece of design, inspired by the UAE's undulating desert dunes and the coral beneath the sea. The Signature Villas possess an elegant charm and nautical allure, rising elegantly from the sea. The Penthouses reflect nature's grandeur, while the Sky Villas soar towards the infinite, providing a home set amongst the stars. Each residence features premium finishes, fully equipped kitchens, and fully furnished interiors, with private infinity pools overlooking the sparkling Arabian Gulf.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the iconic West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah, this exceptional location places residents on one of Dubai's most prestigious and sought-after addresses. The Palm Jumeirah is a place where the sea romances the sky on an iconic stretch of land that has ignited the world's imagination with its endless arc of seascape and skyline. This man-made island offers an exclusive lifestyle with private beaches, ocean views, and proximity to Dubai Marina.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and world-class amenities. Dubai's vibrant city center, world-renowned hotels, fine dining establishments, and luxury retail destinations are all within easy reach. The Palm Jumeirah's monorail and well-planned road networks facilitate seamless movement within and beyond the island, connecting residents to the pulsating heart of Dubai while maintaining a serene, resort-like environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the pinnacle of wellness-focused luxury, iconic design, and a prime Dubai address, Palm Jumeirah delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can connect with oneself, others, and the world around them.
